summary: Recording-based speech-to-text via RealtimeSTT (faster-whisper + VAD). Built for Subtitld's Record mode; also transcribes imported audio. GPU-accelerated when available.
author: Subtitld

fields.label: Model
fields.description: faster-whisper model used by RealtimeSTT. Larger = more accurate but slower and heavier. Downloaded from Hugging Face on first use and cached.

fields.label: Device
fields.description: Where inference runs. 'auto' uses CUDA when a compatible GPU is present, otherwise CPU.

fields.label: Compute type
fields.description: faster-whisper precision. 'default' lets the backend choose; 'int8' is fastest on CPU; 'float16' suits GPUs.

fields.label: Stream interim results
fields.description: Emit refining partial text while a phrase is still being decoded. Turn off for a single final result per phrase.
